title: Quantitative Acid-Base Neutralization Titration
description: Standardization of hydrochloric acid against sodium hydroxide with phenolphthalein indicator and pH probe tracking.
apparatus: Magnetic Stirrer Plate with PTFE Stir Bar
steps: Pipette 25.0 mL of 0.10 M HCl into the Erlenmeyer flask.
Add 3 drops of phenolphthalein indicator solution.
Position flask on magnetic stirrer and insert calibrated pH electrode.
Slowly dispense 0.10 M NaOH from burette while continuously monitoring pH.
Record the volume at the persistent pale pink equivalence endpoint (pH 7.0 - 8.2).
Compute analyte molarity using n_acid = n_base.
safety: Corrosive reagents. Wear nitrile protective gloves and chemical splash goggles.
